summary: Implemented the T034 data-quality and completeness report module under src/robinhood_lp/quality/. The module ships: (a) a closed set of reason codes covering every defect listed in the contract (range_coverage_gap, block_hash_gap, duplicate_event_key, misordered_log, unknown_pool, decode_error, impossible_value, stale_endpoint, metadata_failure, cross_provider_discrepancy, budget_exhausted, capability_regression, user_agent_rejected, cross_endpoint_sample_missing, cross_endpoint_sample_disagree, infrastructure_correlation_state_unrecorded, checkpoint_mismatch); (b) the InfrastructureCorrelationState enum (unknown_not_proven / known_correlated / evidenced_independent) with the cross_endpoint_agreement wording helper that only emits independent_provider_agreement when the state is evidenced_independent; (c) Decision 6 deterministic sample selection with five required-sample rules (per-run chain/code hash, per-partition opening+trailing 10-block windows, per-event-type smallest-EventKey window with dedup, per-failover pre+post 10-block windows, result-bearing requirement); (d) the QualityReport value object with machine-readable + human-readable summaries, capability snapshot, paired preflight/actual budget ledger, provider-to-interval provenance, response/storage volume, deviations ledger, and shared-infrastructure evidence; (e) a verifier that returns VerificationResult(complete, blockers, details) applying all six acceptance clauses. Tests: 61 unit tests in tests/test_quality_report.py plus a shared fixture module tests/_quality_t034_fixtures.py covering seeded defect fixtures (parametrised across all 17 reason codes), the five A+B sample rules (including dedup of identical event-type windows and the genesis-boundary failover edge case), determinism (two calls with identical inputs return byte-identical samples), infrastructure-correlation state constraints (default is unknown_not_proven, residual-risk callout present for unknown_not_proven and known_correlated, absent for evidenced_independent), wording constraint (cross_endpoint_agreement used by default and human summary; independent_provider_agreement rejected unless state is evidenced_independent), warning counts visible in aggregates (per-deviation and per-finding), topology basis (cold-start requires coverage_from <= pool_init_block, warm-run requires qualified_checkpoint_ref, backtest-window-only requires either Initialize or checkpoint), result-bearing requirement (verifier rejects all-empty capability probes when dataset has events), and complete=true vs complete=false across every blocker code (budget exhausted, sample missing, sample disagree, manifest checksum missing, manifest checksum drift). Full pytest suite: 682 passed, 6 unrelated skips. ruff format / ruff check / mypy / git diff --check all clean.
